title: werf-giterminism.yaml
description:
werf giterminism configuration. Every directive loosens a giterminism restriction; without the file all restrictions are enforced.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/reference/werf_giterminism_yaml.html

giterminismConfigVersion.description: Config syntax version. It should always be 1 for now.

CLI.description: The rules of loosening giterminism for the CLI.

allowCustomTags.description: Allow the use of the --use-custom-tag option.

Config.description: The rules of loosening giterminism for the werf configuration file (werf.yaml).

allowUncommitted.description: Read the configuration file from the project directory despite the state in the git repository and .gitignore rules.

allowUncommittedTemplates.description: Globs of configuration file templates (.werf/**/*.tmpl) to read from the project directory despite the state in the git repository and .gitignore rules.

ConfigGoTemplateRendering.description: The rules for the Go-template functions.

allowEnvVariables.description:
Environment variables allowed in the env function: exact names or /REGEXP/.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/project_configuration/giterminism.html#env

allowUncommittedFiles.description: Globs of files to read from the project directory in .Files.Exists, .Files.Get, .Files.Glob and .Files.IsDir despite the state in the git repository and .gitignore rules.

ConfigSecrets.description: The rules for using secret values in the build.

allowFiles.description: Globs of file paths allowed as secrets.

allowValueIds.description: Identifiers of arbitrary secret values allowed in the build.

allowFromLatest.description:
Allow the use of the fromLatest directive.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/project_configuration/giterminism.html#fromlatest

ConfigStapelGit.description: The rules for the git directive.

allowBranch.description:
Allow the use of the branch directive for remote repositories.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/project_configuration/giterminism.html#branch

ConfigStapelMount.description: The rules for the mount directive.

allowBuildDir.description:
Allow the use of the build_dir mount ({ from: build_dir, ... }).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/project_configuration/giterminism.html#build_dir

allowFromPaths.description:
Globs of host paths allowed in fromPath mounts ({ fromPath: <path>, ... }).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/project_configuration/giterminism.html#frompath

allowUncommitted.description: Globs of Dockerfiles to read from the project directory despite the state in the git repository and .gitignore rules.

allowUncommittedDockerignoreFiles.description: Globs of .dockerignore and .containerignore files to read from the project directory despite the state in the git repository and .gitignore rules.

allowContextAddFiles.description:
Files or directories from the project directory allowed in the contextAddFiles directive.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/project_configuration/giterminism.html#contextaddfiles

Helm.description: The rules of loosening giterminism for the helm files (.helm).

allowUncommittedFiles.description: Globs of helm files to read from the project directory despite the state in the git repository and .gitignore rules.

Includes.description: The rules of loosening giterminism for the configuration includes.

allowIncludesUpdate.description: Allow using current commits for tags and branches of remote repositories without checking them against the lock file.
